title: On the approximation of posterior laws in compound loss models by conditional Wasserstein GANs
abstract: arXiv:2608.27229v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian inference in compound loss models must often be repeated across policies, market scenarios, and prior specifications. Outside conjugate cases, this may require repeated numerical integration or Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). We formulate this problem as amortized posterior approximation and construct a conditional Wasserstein generative adversarial network conditioned on sufficient statistics, prior mean and coefficient of variation, and mixture weights of prior families. Notably, a single shared generator is able to approximate the posterior laws of both the Poisson intensity and the Pareto shape parameter under mixtures of Gamma, inverse-Gaussian, and lognormal priors. We assess the approximation by simulation-based calibration and by comparisons with analytical posteriors, deterministic quadrature, and extensive MCMC simulations. translated_title: 复合损失模型中后验分布的近似：基于条件Wasserstein生成对抗网络
translated_abstract: 在复合损失模型中进行贝叶斯推断时，通常需要针对不同的保单、市场情景和先验设定重复进行。在非共轭情形下，这可能涉及重复的数值积分或马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）方法。我们将此问题表述为摊销后验近似，并构建了一个条件Wasserstein生成对抗网络，该网络以充分统计量、先验均值和变异系数以及先验族的混合权重为条件。值得注意的是，一个共享的生成器能够在Gamma、逆高斯和对数正态先验的混合下，近似泊松强度和帕累托形状参数的后验分布。我们通过基于仿真的校准以及与解析后验、确定性求积和广泛MCMC模拟的比较来评估该近似。在极端自然灾害损失数据的应用中，我们生成了滚动的一年期预测。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于条件Wasserstein生成对抗网络的摊销后验近似方法，能够在复合损失模型中高效地同时近似多个参数的后验分布，避免了重复的数值积分或MCMC计算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an amortized posterior approximation method using conditional Wasserstein GANs, which efficiently approximates posterior distributions of multiple parameters in compound loss models, avoiding repeated numerical integration or MCMC computations.
